title: Cargo for the Isle
html:
Quest chain · part 1 of 2, 1 more after this one
1Cargo for the Isle→2The Ogre Traitor→🔓 Access to Ogre Isle
The supplies bound for Ogre Isle never got there. Ogres holed up east of Underleaf took them off the road.

About

Given byGerald Seabroden
Level30
LengthMedium
KindStory
Quest points2

What you need

Not known yet: the data for this quest is incomplete.

Steps

  1. Talk to Gerald Seabroden (outdoors near Plymouth Wharf) to get the quest.
  2. Kill ogres in the Ogre Den, east of Underleaf, until you have 5 Crates of Ogre Isle Supplies (a quest item). The den's ogres are level 29 at the entrance up to 33 at the bottom.
  3. Bring them back to Gerald Seabroden to finish the quest.

Steps 2 and 3 are as reported by players who finished it; the crate and the Ogre Den are from the game itself, the den’s levels from the news (Ogre Isle Opens at Thirty, 26 Sep 2026: they were 35 to 40 before).

Rewards

Reward
Gold600
Character XP27,000
Quest points2

Unlocks

The Ogre Traitor, the next quest in the chain to Ogre Isle.
